name: Address Autocomplete
description: Adds type-ahead address lookup to the Address field via a server-side proxy to a geocoding provider (Swiss Post, Google Places, Mapbox, or the French BAN).

suggests.drupal/webform: ^6.1 — provides an 'Advanced address with autocomplete' Webform composite element

project_description:
This module enhances the Address module with autocomplete functionality.

 When you start to type the street, a list of matching addresses will be shown. When you pick one all relevant address fields (like street, city, postcode, country) will be populated.

 Multiple providers can be configured: Swiss Post API, Google Maps (Places), Mapbox Geocoding, and the French Base Adresse Nationale. Providers are pluggable (AddressProvider plugin type) so custom providers can be added by extending AddressProviderBase.
